free_tier.stated: no hosted tier: the project is self-hosted software for x86_64 Linux with KVM, so there is no capacity to buy; it ships a compatible API gateway and an egress filter

per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

interface_detail: Access interface not documented in published terms.

limits.value: self-hosted software: users must supply x86_64 Linux with KVM, so there is no hosted capacity
CubeEgress filters egress by L7 domain and audits it, with kernel policies so traffic cannot skip inspection
cold start is 60 ms at single concurrency and the P99 is 137 ms under 50 concurrent creations

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented. No rate published.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: not stated in the source card. `email` is the assumed value because every priced host in the set requires an account, and no signup was performed, so the kind is not established for this provider

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded in the source passes
confidence_note: the repository was read on 2026-10-22 and states the KVM requirement, the benchmarked cold start and the egress gateway. There is no hosted product, so the verdict stays paid-only with a better reason: it is software users run

evidence.proved: listed in the peli-cloud corpus card at commit f6a71ab0; the card is the source, not the vendor page

'Cube Sandbox requires an x86_64 Linux environment with KVM support' and 'Cold start benchmarked on bare-metal. 60ms at single concurrency; under 50 concurrent creations, avg 67ms, P95 90ms, P99 137ms' with 'CubeEgress  -  OpenResty-based egress security gateway: L7 domain filtering, credential injection, and access auditing', quoted

notes: Reclassified: no free tier on the catalogue card is a paid-only product, not a closed one. `dead` is reserved for a product that is withdrawn or unreachable.

session_cap.note: a sandbox starts in 60 ms and pause/resume is supported across nodes; the client's own host sets the clocks

extras.price_note: a price without a shape and a horizon is not a price; both columns are kept because the two seed models disagree and neither is wrong
